rows.en: "Flag 1B0 has not been set. To play this private
event, set flag 1B0 and try again.
Otherwise, the event will be forcibly terminated."<FC:B4:3E>
Fain: "Hmm? Oh, what is it?
Have you come to study cool opening proclamations too?"
Touya: "...No, I'm not into that."
Fain: "...What a strange fellow. There can be no other reason
for coming here, can there?"
Touya: "Don't lump me in with you."
Fain: "I see! You're planning to make your own,
in secret, aren't you?!"
Touya: "..."
Yamato: "...Well, shall we go?"
Touya: "Y-Yeah..."
Fain: "Heh heh heh... Trying to keep secrets from Fain Jin Barion...
...Huh? Touya? Heeey..."
Fain: "Aha! Just as I thought..."
Touya: "Come on, let's go."
Yamato: "Oh, wait, Touya!"
Yamato: "Huh? The elevator's moving. You don't see that often.
Is someone on it, I wonder?"
Touya: "Well, people do ride it."
Yamato: "But every time I look, it's stopped.
Right on the floor I'm on, too."
Touya: "You're imagining things. Imagining things. Anyway..."
Yamato: "Oh, it stopped."
Fain: "Hahahahaha!
To defend my beloved, the blade of justice smites the enemy!
With crimson blood burning red, such is a man's path in life!
A man of justice and truth!
Faaain, Jiiin, Baaaarion!!
I have arrived! For justice... I can die!"
Yamato: "..."
Touya: "..."
Fain: "...Huh?"
Yamato: "..."
Touya: "..."
Fain: "Aah!"
Fain: "H-Hey! Don't ignore me!
I was waiting specially for you..."
Touya: "...Get Gabon to take a look at you sometime."
Fain: "What?! I couldn't be healthier!
I'm not weak enough to get sick!
Dahahahaha!"
Yamato: "...It's a serious case."
Fain: "...So, what did you think? I'm pretty confident
in this one. Ah, my own talent frightens me."
It's pretty good, isn't it?
It's like enka.
Fain: "Isn't it? Especially the last part!
I get a thrill just saying it."
Yamato: "He's lost in admiration of himself... It's terminal."
Touya: "R-Right. Well, keep at it."
Fain: "'Enka'? What's that?"
Yamato: "Hmm... Maybe something like 'the song of the Japanese
heart'?"
Fain: "Heart? You mean a song that resonates
straight through the soul?"
Yamato: "W-Well, something like that."
Fain: "Oh! So my proclamation is just that
magnificent!"
Yamato: "Y-Yeah... Maybe..."
Fain: "Dahahahaha! You understand perfectly!"
Yamato: "By the way, Fain, why are you so
straightforward?"
Fain: "Heh heh heh... Because I believe in justice!
Dying for it would be my heart's desire!
And that justice is also for protecting those I hold dear!"
Touya: "Huh. Those you hold dear, eh..."
Fain: "Yes! For the princess, for Miss Ymir,
and for K-Kasumi... No! My justice is not
so fickle! Oh, what am I to do...?"
Yamato: "...What do we do?"
Touya: "Better keep our distance..."
Fain: "We're friends, aren't we?!
Tell me, who am I supposed to fight for?
I've decided in my heart that I'll love only one woman.
But I bear the noble and supreme
duty of guarding the princess. I can abandon neither love nor loyalty.
Ah... What a trial! This is the fate of a knight!
Then I shall press on! To fight destiny!
No, wait. But if one desires too much at once,
it's the same as losing everything, as my master said.
Does that mean I must follow one path or the other?!
Oh! How can this be?!
And choosing between Miss Ymir and Kasumi...
Damn it! It's all because those ≪Ze=Ode≫ bastards...
If not for them, I would never have had to suffer
like this...
Wait! Is this their conspiracy?!
Grrrrr! Damn them... How despicable...
No, how fearsome ≪Ze=Ode≫ is!
But I, Fain Jin Barion, will not let a little thing like that
break my spirit! Hmm? Does that mean,
to turn their plan against them, I must preserve my love for two women
and my loyalty to the princess
all at once?
No, but then I'd be defying my master's teaching.
Aaaah! What am I supposed to doooo?!"
Fain: "...Huh? Touya? Heeey..."
Yamato: "...He has it hard too."
Touya: "Well, he seems to find it fulfilling in his own way.
Anyway, let's go."
Yamato: "Y-Yeah..."
